title: Rovay na door watan to
body:
Rovay na door watan ton shala beemar koye
Nangay sir vaikhay na puphiyan (x2) bharai bazaar koye
1) Des apnay ch na perdesi koi vi hovay,
Dekh berjayaina nu sir nangai koi na rovai,
Javai her mor tay rukdi (x2) na perday daar koye
2) Dekhai na putar tai gal tauq zulam day paindai,
Naizay ton waikh na bachri day koi dur rendai,
Shala ghash khaway sina tay (x2) na baar baar koye
3) Shaam wich pur jinay lay kay hay beemar gaya,
Dekh kai veer bazaran kun jivain ronda raiya,
Rovay na khoon day athru (x2) ainj salaar koye
4) Koi mastoor kadi shala na pavay kariyan,
Waikh darbar day wich behnra tay puphiyan khariyan,
Hovay Sajjad day vangoun (x2) na bay qarara koye
5) Tera Khursheed karey Mola aey ro ro kay dua,
Gham Kissay nu na milay koi teray gham day siva,
Rovay gham teray day bajoun (x2) na azadaar koye
